news.headline: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Announces an Investigation Against Nektar Therapeutics (NKTR) and Encourages Stockholders to Learn More About the Investigation
Nektar's (NKTR) Billion-Dollar Balance Sheet Faces A Multi-Year Test
news.summary: The piece frames the bear case: $1.02 billion of cash funds a roughly two-year wait to the mid-2028 ZENITH AD readout and into second-half 2029 for the ~850-patient alopecia areata Phase 3, against full-year R&D guidance of $210-230 million and revenue capped near $45 million, mostly non-cash royalties. It cited short interest around 19.9% of float and hedge fund holders falling from 56 to 50 quarter over quarter.

news.headline: Nektar Announces Publication in The Lancet of Positive Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD 16-Week Induction Results of Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: The Lancet published the full 16-week induction dataset from the 393-patient REZOLVE-AD Phase 2b run across 107 sites in 10 countries: mean EASI reductions of 61%, 58% and 53% across dose arms versus 31% for placebo (p<0.0001), with EASI-75 at 42% versus 17%, and significant separation as early as Week 2 in the 24 ug/kg arms. Serious adverse events occurred in 2% of participants with no deaths and no signal for infections or conjunctivitis, the first peer-reviewed validation that selective Treg expansion produces clinically meaningful skin outcomes.

news.headline: JPMorgan Initiates Coverage on Nektar Therapeutics with Neutral Rating and $65 Price Target
news.summary: JPMorgan started NKTR at Neutral with a $65 target, the second cautious voice after Wedbush's $80 (cut from $95 in August). Both sit far below Piper Sandler's Overweight rating and $192 target and below the sell-side average near $144, which still skews Strong Buy across roughly a dozen analysts.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics v. Eli Lilly & Co: Court Confirms September 8, 2026 Jury Trial in San Francisco
news.summary: The breach-of-contract suit over the pair's terminated rezpegaldesleukin collaboration is going to trial before an 8-person jury: Nektar alleges Lilly used flawed statistics that understated efficacy (about 66% versus a true ~83%) and mismanaged the ISLAND lupus trial and the AD/psoriasis analyses, seeking damages for lost milestone and royalty payments, while Lilly denies wrongdoing and blames a third-party CRO calculation error. A pretrial conference was held August 6, and as of this update the trial remains on track to open September 8, 2026.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Cash and investments stood at $1,023.4 million on June 30, 2026 versus $245.8 million at year-end 2025, helped by the $373.8 million April equity raise, extending runway into Q3 2028 and past the targeted mid-2028 ZENITH AD readout. Net loss was $40.6 million ($1.23 per share) on revenue of $10.1 million (just under the $10.5 million consensus), and management reaffirmed a ZENITH AD-3 start in September, a Phase 3 alopecia areata start in early 2027, and a first rezpegaldesleukin BLA in 2029.

news.headline: Nektar Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program for Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Nektar began randomizing patients in ZENITH AD-1 and AD-2, two roughly 510-patient global registrational trials in biologic/JAK-naive patients aged 12 and older, part of an approximately 1,530-patient three-study program across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. The design followed FDA end-of-Phase 2 meetings and EMA scientific advice, targeting initial topline data in mid-2028 and a BLA in 2029.

catalysts.label: Nektar v. Eli Lilly jury trial begins (N.D. Cal., San Francisco)
catalysts.detail: Trial is set to open September 8, 2026 before an 8-person jury, structured as roughly 13 hours per side. Nektar alleges Lilly mismanaged and misreported rezpeg efficacy data and the ISLAND lupus trial during their terminated collaboration and seeks damages for lost milestone and royalty payments; Lilly denies wrongdoing. As of September 5, no verdict exists and no further postponement has been reported; this remains a genuinely binary legal catalyst uncorrelated with the clinical story, with both duration and outcome unpredictable.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 initiation (biologic/JAK-experienced patients)
catalysts.detail: The third roughly 510-patient Phase 3 study, enrolling atopic dermatitis patients with prior systemic biologic and/or JAK inhibitor experience, is guided to begin in September 2026 after the July 21 starts of ZENITH AD-1 and AD-2. It completes the registrational package for both U.S. and European filings and tests rezpeg in the harder-to-treat population that already failed Dupixent or a JAK. Management reaffirmed the September timing on the August 13 Q2 call; no separate start announcement has been issued yet.

catalysts.label: Two oral presentations at the 35th EADV Congress, Vienna (Sept 30 - Oct 3)
catalysts.detail: Nektar has two accepted oral presentations at EADV 2026 at the Austria Center Vienna: Thomas Bieber on durable and deepening improvements with monthly and quarterly dosing from the REZOLVE-AD maintenance period, and David Rosmarin on 52-week Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA results in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata. Maintenance durability at reduced dosing frequency is the main commercial differentiator versus Dupixent, so the dermatology community's reception matters more than the headline numbers.

catalysts.label: 24-week off-treatment alopecia areata topline (REZOLVE-AA)
catalysts.detail: Management guided on the Q2 call to report topline data from the 24-week off-treatment period of REZOLVE-AA in Q4 2026, to inform long-term maintenance dosing ahead of the Phase 3 start. Durability off drug is the key differentiator versus chronically dosed JAK inhibitors like Litfulo and Olumiant. The exact date and venue have not been named.

catalysts.label: First NKTR-0165 (TNFR2 agonist) preclinical data at a scientific conference
catalysts.detail: Management has guided to presenting preclinical data for NKTR-0165, its bivalent TNFR2 agonist antibody, at a scientific conference in the second half of 2026. It is the only meaningful pipeline asset behind rezpeg and is paired with a February 2026 research collaboration with UCSF and Dr. Stephen Hauser in multiple sclerosis. Venue and date are not yet named, so slippage into 2027 is possible.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Consensus tracking services list November 5, 2026 as the expected Q3 report date, though Nektar has not yet issued a formal confirmation. The release should update cash burn against full-year R&D guidance of $210-230 million, confirm the ZENITH AD-3 start, give first enrollment colour across all three Phase 3 AD studies, and address the financial and strategic consequences of the September 8 Eli Lilly jury trial outcome.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 alopecia areata study start (~850 patients)
catalysts.detail: Management reaffirmed on the Q2 call that it will start a single registrational Phase 3 in severe alopecia areata in early 2027, sized at roughly 850 patients, based on the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA proof-of-concept (28.2% mean SALT reduction on 24 ug/kg every two weeks versus 11.2% for placebo at 36 weeks). Rezpeg holds FDA Fast Track in this indication and the readout is guided to the second half of 2029, so this is a program-expansion milestone rather than a value-inflection event.

catalysts.label: 52-week off-treatment atopic dermatitis data
catalysts.detail: Management guided to present 52-week off-treatment data for atopic dermatitis in Q1 2027 to further inform long-term maintenance dosing while the ZENITH AD Phase 3s enroll. It builds on earlier signals of roughly nine months of off-treatment durability, the core of the argument that rezpeg could be dosed far less frequently than incumbent biologics.

catalysts.label: First ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline readout (mid-2028)
catalysts.detail: Initial registrational efficacy data for rezpeg in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis is the decisive binary event for the equity. Cash runway extends into Q3 2028, so the company reaches this readout without needing another raise. Replicating the Phase 2b 61%-versus-31% mean EASI delta at Phase 3 scale is essentially what the consensus target near $144 discounts.

catalysts.label: First rezpegaldesleukin BLA submission (atopic dermatitis)
catalysts.detail: Nektar has guided to a first BLA filing for rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis in 2029 following the mid-2028 ZENITH AD topline. The Phase 3 program was designed with EMA scientific advice in parallel, so a European marketing authorisation application is intended off the same dataset.

pulse: NKTR trades around $74-76 (a September 5 intraday range of $73.66-$76.04) for a market cap near $2.53 billion inside a wide 52-week range of $27.87 to $109.00, with financing risk off the table: $1.02 billion of cash funds runway into Q3 2028, past the mid-2028 ZENITH AD Phase 3 readout. The dominant near-term development is legal rather than clinical - the Nektar v. Eli Lilly jury trial is set to open September 8 in San Francisco over the pair's soured rezpeg collaboration, a binary and uncorrelated wildcard - arriving days after The Lancet's August 25 peer-reviewed publication of the REZOLVE-AD Phase 2b data, which gave the Treg-stimulating mechanism its strongest scientific validation yet, and a split sell-side reaction (JPMorgan Neutral/$65 and Wedbush $80 versus Piper Sandler's Overweight/$192 and a Strong Buy consensus near $144). Watch the Lilly trial's start and any early signals on length/outcome, the ZENITH AD-3 start and two EADV Congress presentations (Sept 30-Oct 3) on maintenance-dosing durability and alopecia data, the Q4 alopecia off-treatment topline, and Q3 earnings expected around November 5.
